Tive B.P. Khumalo is a PhD candidate in the [Statistics, Measurement, and Evaluation in Education](https://education.missouri.edu/educational-school-counseling-psychology/degrees-programs/statistics-measurement-evaluation-education/) program at the College of Education and Human Development of the University of Missouri.

Specific research interests include:

- Bayesian statistical inference and regularization
- Structural equation modeling
- Longitudinal data
- Measurement
- Latent Modeling
- Statistical computing
- Bayesian spatial modeling
- Machine Learning hyper-parameter tuning and regularization

You can find an overview of my publications, and current projects
